data.long_meaning: From the Old English word ‘ælfstan’ which means ‘noble or rocky’. The name Alston carries the meaning “Noble or Rocky” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Alston usually hope their child will grow to embody noble or rocky and live with faith, good character and purpose.
